scope: Decoder cache arenas and resource loaders; exact coverage is computed by the normal build verifier.

relationships.evidence: The size queries return 0x659c code bytes and 0x2580 table bytes. Initializers round available sizes down to four-byte multiples and clear the associated cache slots.
Getters return an existing cache, copy the corresponding embedded resource into the appropriate arena when space remains, or return the original embedded resource address.

uncertainty: These functions copy or return embedded decoder resources. Their matching status does not establish recovery of the decoder code they reference.
